hoi4modutilities.useConditionInFocus.des: Show conditions in the focus tree preview. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.focusTreeLayout.title: Focus tree: layout
hoi4modutilities.focusTreeLayout.desc: Where the focus tree preview takes its layout from. Pick gui for a mod that changes nationalfocusview.gui.
hoi4modutilities.focusTreeLayout.enum.st: The built-in layout, the same for every mod.
hoi4modutilities.focusTreeLayout.enum.gu: Take the layout from the mod's interface/nationalfocusview.gui (then parent mods, then the game): focus spacing, grid offset, where the icon, title bar, name and overlay sit, the prerequisite line ends and the mutually exclusive link. Anything the file does not define keeps the built-in value.
hoi4modutilities.focusTreePrerequisiteLi: Which of the game's prerequisite line colours the focus tree preview draws.
Blue, as the game draws the lines of focuses not yet completed.
Green, as the game draws the lines of completed focuses.
hoi4modutilities.eventTreePreview.title: Event Tree Preview
hoi4modutilities.eventTreePreview.desc: Enable the event tree preview feature. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.decisionPreview.title: Decision Preview
hoi4modutilities.decisionPreview.desc: Enable the decision preview feature. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.ideaPreview.title: Idea Preview
hoi4modutilities.ideaPreview.desc: Enable the idea preview feature. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.characterPreview.title: Character Preview
hoi4modutilities.characterPreview.desc: Enable the character preview feature. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.bopPreview.title: Balance of Power Preview
hoi4modutilities.bopPreview.desc: Enable the balance of power preview feature. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.ideaSwapIndex.title: Idea Swap Index
hoi4modutilities.ideaSwapIndex.desc: Scan common and events for swap_ideas so the idea preview can show idea chains. Reads a lot of files the first time it is built. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.sharedFocusIndex.title: Shared Focus Index
hoi4modutilities.sharedFocusIndex.desc: Build an index of shared focuses for cross-file lookups. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.gfxIndex.title: GFX Index
hoi4modutilities.gfxIndex.desc: Build an index of GFX sprite definitions. Uses more memory. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.imageDecodeWorkers.desc: Maximum number of worker threads used to decode DDS/TGA images to PNG. Higher values render icon-heavy previews (focus trees) faster but use more CPU and memory. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.localisationIndex.title: Localisation Index
hoi4modutilities.localisationIndex.desc: Build a localisation index to show translated text in previews. Uses more memory. Reloading is required after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.installPath.title: Install Path
hoi4modutilities.installPath.desc: Hearts of Iron IV install path. If you are on web, you should press Ctrl+Shift+P, and type "Select HOI4 Install Path" command instead of this setting.
hoi4modutilities.loadDlcContents.title: Load DLC Contents
hoi4modutilities.loadDlcContents.desc: Whether to load DLC images when previewing files. Enabling this will use more memory.
hoi4modutilities.modFile.title: Working Mod File
hoi4modutilities.modFile.desc: Path to the working .mod file. This file is used to read replace_path. If not specified, will use first .mod file in first folder of the workspace. Meant as a workspace setting: set in user settings it applies to every window, so another mod opened on this machine would use the same file. The Select mod file command writes it to the workspace.
hoi4modutilities.preview.title: Preview HOI4 file
hoi4modutilities.previewworld.title: Preview World Map
hoi4modutilities.scanreferences.title: Scan references and add them as dependencies
hoi4modutilities.selecthoifolder.title: Select HOI4 Install Path
hoi4modutilities.showindexstatus.title: Show Index Status
hoi4modutilities.selectmodfile.title: Select Mod File
hoi4modutilities.enableSupplyArea.title: Enable Supply Area
hoi4modutilities.enableSupplyArea.desc: If you are developing mod for HOI4(version<=1.10). Check this to enable supply area. Reopen the preview after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.previewLocalisation.des: Language of content in event tree preview.
hoi4modutilities.parentModPaths.title: Parent mod paths
hoi4modutilities.parentModPaths.desc: Absolute folders of the mods this workspace extends (for a submod), searched in order after the workspace folders and before the Hearts of Iron IV install and DLCs. The mods named in the selected .mod file's dependencies are found through the launcher's mod registry and appended after these; an entry here wins over the registry for the same mod. Meant as a workspace setting: set in user settings it applies to every window, so another mod or submod opened on this machine would use the same parents. A folder that is also a workspace folder is skipped.
hoi4modutilities.userDataPath.title: User data path
hoi4modutilities.userDataPath.desc: The Hearts of Iron IV user data folder, the one holding dlc_load.json and the mod folder the launcher writes. Used to resolve the dependencies of the selected .mod file to folders. Found automatically when empty.
hoi4modutilities.previewWheel.title: Previews: what the mouse wheel does
hoi4modutilities.previewWheel.desc: What a plain mouse wheel does in the focus tree, technology, MIO, event and decision previews. Ctrl+wheel, the zoom buttons and the +/- keys zoom whatever this is set to. Reopen the preview after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.previewWheel.enum.auto: Zoom when the wheel is a mouse wheel, scroll when it is a two-finger trackpad swipe.
hoi4modutilities.previewWheel.enum.scrol: The wheel always scrolls; zoom with Ctrl+wheel, the zoom buttons or the +/- keys.
hoi4modutilities.inlayWindowGfxRoots.des: Workspace/mod-relative folders scanned first for the .gfx files focus inlay windows use (e.g. "interface/scripted_gui"). The whole interface/ folder is always scanned after them. An inlay_window_gfx_roots = { ... } list in the mod's .mod file adds to this.
hoi4modutilities.focusOverlayGfxFiles.de: Workspace/mod-relative .gfx files, or folders scanned for .gfx files, that define the mod's focus overlay sprites (e.g. "interface/goals_overlays.gfx"). The game's interface/goals.gfx is always searched first. A focus_overlay_gfx = { ... } list in the mod's .mod file adds to this.
hoi4modutilities.decisionGfxFiles.title: Decision GFX files
hoi4modutilities.decisionGfxFiles.desc: Workspace/mod-relative .gfx files, or folders scanned for .gfx files, that define the mod's decision sprites (e.g. "interface/MD_decisions.gfx"). The game's interface/decisions.gfx is always searched first. A decision_gfx = { ... } list in the mod's .mod file adds to this.
hoi4modutilities.ideaPlaceholderIcon.des: Workspace/mod-relative image drawn for an idea whose picture does not resolve (e.g. "gfx/interface/ideas/WIP_idea.dds"). Used when the mod's .mod file has no idea_placeholder_icon = "..." line; the game's gfx/interface/ideas/idea_PLACEHOLDER.dds is drawn when neither names an existing file.
hoi4modutilities.characterTraitStructura: Keys a mod writes flat on its character traits that describe the trait rather than grant a modifier (e.g. "my_trait_category"), so the character preview does not show them as modifier lines. The base game's own keys are always recognised. A character_trait_structural_keys = { ... } list in the mod's .mod file adds to this.
hoi4modutilities.technologyGfxRoots.desc: Workspace/mod-relative root folders to scan recursively for .gfx files used by the technology tree preview, including country-specific technology icons (e.g. "interface/technologies").
Add a country selector to the technology tree preview and prefer that country's icons (GFX_<TAG>_<technology>) over the generic ones, the way the game does. Needs the GFX index to list the countries.
hoi4modutilities.worldMapRetainContextWh: World map: keep webview in memory when hidden

Keep the world map preview's webview loaded while the tab is hidden (faster to switch back, uses more memory). Turn off to free the webview when hidden and reload it on return, lowering memory use on large maps. The extension-host copy of the map is always released while hidden. Reopen the preview after changing this.
hoi4modutilities.auditfocustrees.title: Check All Focus Trees
hoi4modutilities.auditor.reportFolder.de:
[Check all focus trees](command:mdhoi4utilities.auditfocustrees): checks every focus tree file for the problems the focus tree preview warns about, and lists them per file in one Markdown report you can paste into a GitHub issue.

The folder the report is saved to, as focus-tree-audit.md. A relative path starts at the first workspace folder. Leave it empty to open the report in an unsaved editor tab instead.
Also check the focus tree files of Hearts of Iron IV itself, not only those of the mod.
